title: Caberg Flyon II Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Fly Racing Caberg Flyon II Anthracite is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1342g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~98 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Ultralight carbon open face weighing just 750g for urban riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for an intermediate oval head shape; features a semi-rigid EPS liner with a removable cheek pad system that allows for a snug fit around the cheeks and temples without excessive pressure on the forehead.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Fly Racing Caberg Flyon II Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Fly Racing's Open Face lineup, the Caberg Flyon II Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Fly Racing Caberg Flyon II Anthracite represents Fly Racing's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Fly Racing Caberg Flyon II Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
